text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] When DNA digivolving, your opponent chooses 1 of their Digimon. Delete all of their other Digimon. Then, ＜Blitz＞. [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] This Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn. Then, this Digimon may digivolve into [Imperialdramon: Fighter Mode] in your hand for the digivolution cost.
